package_note: SOT1227A — 10-lead plastic overmoulded, push-pull internal configuration
notes: Industry workhorse for SSR / IFF / TACAN / DME avionics pulse transmitters. Push-pull pair of identical LDMOS dice inside MOS-10 package with internal input matching to 50Ω. Excellent gain flatness 1 kHz–500 MHz. Peak pulsed output 1800 W at 230 MHz, duty cycle typically ≤20 %. Verify exact Pout / gain / DE figures against current datasheet.

package_note: Split / single-ended variant of MOS-10 — each half separately accessible
notes: Single-ended (split) variant of BLF188XR. Two transistors independently accessible, allowing use as balanced pair or as independent high-power single transistors. ~900 W per half. Confirm exact part number and specifications with current Ampleon datasheet.

package_note: Air-cavity ceramic package for CW applications
notes: CW-rated broadband LDMOS for industrial and broadcast CW applications. Lower pulsed handling than BLF188XR — rated for continuous operation. Verify exact performance specifications with current Ampleon datasheet.

package_note: Plastic SMD package, compatible with automated board assembly
notes: Gen9 LDMOS for 700–1000 MHz cellular bands (LTE B8/B20/B28 downlink). 28 V supply, 80 W CW. Suitable as main or peak device in Doherty PA for small/micro cell applications. Confirm exact impedance and efficiency with datasheet.

_comment: === Cellular 1.8–2.1 GHz (2 GHz macro, LTE Band 1/3/4) ===
notes: Gen9 50V LDMOS for 1.8–2.2 GHz cellular macro infrastructure. Covers LTE Band 1 (2.1 GHz) and Band 3 (1800 MHz). Main or peak stage in 130 W Doherty PAs. Verify exact part suffix (e.g. PBG, etc.) with Ampleon current portfolio.

_comment: === Cellular 2.1 GHz (LTE Band 1 — most dominant macro cell band globally) ===

app_notes.title: AN11303 — Doherty PA using BLF7G22LS-160P (2.14 GHz, 160 W avg)

notes: Most referenced Gen9 LDMOS for 2.1 GHz macro cell Doherty PA designs. 50 V, 160 W CW rated. Widely cited in academic PA literature and Ampleon app notes (e.g. AN11303 covers a 160 W average Doherty at 2.14 GHz). Key device for main or peak stage. Download datasheet and AN11303 for precise Ropt, Xopt and matching network topology.

80 W variant of the BLF7G22 Gen9 family. Can serve as main stage in medium-power Doherty, peak stage in 40+80 W asymmetric Doherty, or driver stage in higher-power chains. Same package as BLF7G22LS-160P — useful for matched-pair Doherty designs.
40 W variant — typically used as driver stage in 160 W Doherty chains, or main device in small-cell single-ended PAs. Part of BLF7G22 family giving a complete driver-to-main staged set.

Gen9 LDMOS for LTE Band 7 (2500–2690 MHz) and TD-LTE at 2.6 GHz. 50 V, 70 W CW. Main or peak stage in 2.6 GHz Doherty PAs for macrocell base stations. Gain slightly lower at this frequency vs 2.1 GHz family — budgets should be planned accordingly.
100 W variant in BLF7G27 family (2.6 GHz). Low confidence — verify exact part number, packaging suffix and specifications with current Ampleon product catalogue.

notes: PLACEHOLDER — CLF (Compact LDMOS Family) Gen9 device for 1.7–1.9 GHz. Ampleon's CLF series targets 5G Massive MIMO and broadband multi-band base stations. Exact model number CLF1G7060S requires verification. Download current Ampleon CLF portfolio sheet for confirmed part numbers and specifications.

notes: 700 W GaN Asymmetric Doherty integrated final transistor for 2300-2700 MHz macro cell base stations. Gain/efficiency inferred from catalog sibling C4H27W400AV (400W, same band/technology). package_note: Overmolded plastic DFN, 4.5×4 mm, 6-lead (no exposed leads — land grid style). Very compact thermal footprint. See AN221012 for GaN thermal management; AN11183 for soldering guidelines.

app_notes.title: AN221012 — Thermal characteristics of GaN power transistors
AN11183 — Mounting and soldering of RF transistors in overmolded plastic packages

notes: 10 W broadband GaN driver for 2300–5000 MHz covering multiple 5G/LTE bands (B7/B41/n41/n77/n78). Gen5 GaN on SiC in compact DFN package — suited for mMIMO and small cell line-ups. Catalog predecessor C4H2350N10 (Gen4) shows same specs; Gen5 likely improves on thermal performance (see AN221012). Drain efficiency (19%) is lower than final-stage GaN due to broadband driver bias operating point. Ropt/Xopt NOT available — datasheet was not provided; only application notes (AN221012, AN11183) are in workspace. To upgrade to HIGH confidence: download C5H2350N10.pdf from ampleon.com.
